news.title: Funding AI: IPOs are sending a new signal | J.P. Morgan Private Bank U.S.
news.snippet: Funding the artificial intelligence (AI) buildout began with cash—over $700 bill...
news.raw_snippet:
Funding the artificial intelligence (AI) buildout began with cash—over $700 billion sitting on the balance sheets of the biggest tech companies in the world. Then came private capital, with alternative investors expected to supply $1.4 trillion over the next five years, followed by a wave of public corporate debt issuance to the tune of $2.1 trillion of expected AI-related debt financing over the same period. Now, the next level of financing is moving into one of the most traditional venues: [...] Companies in the United States are on track to raise around $290 billion in 2026 through just IPOs, approaching the 2021 peak of roughly $330 billion.1 That marks one of the strongest years of issuance in the last two decades before accounting for secondary offerings, special purpose acquisition companies (SPACs) or convertible notes. But just as the AI buildout grows, so do the capital markets. It’s a large amount, but in the context of today’s $70 trillion stock market, expected issuance [...] IPOs with a $100 billion raise and $2 trillion valuation have been estimated to have a 1%–1.2% weight in the NASDAQ 100 and S&P Total Market Index.2 In the MSCI World Indexes, large IPOs can amount to a weight of roughly 10–11 basis points and be considered for early inclusion as soon as the 10th trading day.

Even with a pipeline of private companies ultimately debuting in the public markets, the case to stay private for longer still holds. It’s the role of public markets that’s changing.

news.title: Valuation Multiples for Startups: A Quick Guide for Founders | NetSuite
news.snippet: No surprise: AI has the highest valuations. Aventis Advisors puts the median rev...
news.raw_snippet: No surprise: AI has the highest valuations. Aventis Advisors puts the median revenue multiple in a sample of recent large AI funding rounds and acquisitions at 24.2 times, with the highest individual transaction at 225 times. Aventis cautions that the sample skews toward the largest, most successful companies, “so founders looking to sell their AI startups should take this data with a grain of salt. The valuation multiple will likely be significantly lower in the sale offer you receive.” [...] Investors and acquirers also place more weight on profit than revenue growth when valuing IT services startups, although the absolute size of the business matters a lot, too. An Aventis analysis of M&A transactions of IT services businesses from 2015 to mid-2026 notes a median EV/EBITDA multiple of 10.4 times for the period, with a peak of 12.7 times in 2023 and a low of 8.5 times in 2020. The median for 2025 was 9.5 times. AI is dividing this category, too. Data analytics, cybersecurity, and [...] Two startups with the same $10 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR) can walk out of a fundraising round with very different valuations. That’s because there is no single tech startup valuation multiple in 2026. Investors now price AI-native companies and traditional software-as-a-service (SaaS) businesses as separate markets, and a startup gets the multiple of whichever market investors decide it’s in. news.snippet: However, today’s AI leaders differ from the late-1990s tech cohort. They are pro...
news.raw_snippet:
However, today’s AI leaders differ from the late-1990s tech cohort. They are profitable, cash-generative and integrated into enterprise and consumer infrastructure. Valuation risks persist, but vulnerabilities are more likely to stem from multiple compression or slower adoption than from business-model failure. Selectivity and diversification remain the best ways to capture upside while managing downside risk.

Investors should prepare for greater dispersion both within and across markets [...] Anchor with quality and income: In a slowing growth, valuation-rich environment, combine resilient, high-quality companies with businesses offering strong shareholder returns through dividends and buybacks
 Participate in the next wave of innovation: As the AI cycle evolves, invest in its adopters and other structural themes driving long-term productivity, security and sustainability. [...] ## From euphoria to rebalancing

Global equities extended their rally in 2025, fuelled by the extraordinary momentum around artificial intelligence (AI). Optimism about a productivity revolution, falling inflation and resilient growth supported sentiment, while expectations of rate cuts boosted risk appetite.

news.title: Why CEOs Must Think Like AI-Native Competitors
news.snippet: Consider product development. Traditionally, product leaders have spent signific...
news.raw_snippet: Consider product development. Traditionally, product leaders have spent significant time managing roadmaps, coordinating development teams, and ensuring new capabilities are delivered on schedule. AI can increasingly support portions of that work, creating an opportunity for product leaders to focus more heavily on identifying customer needs and developing differentiated solutions. As AI becomes more capable of translating ideas into working products, creativity and the ability to direct these [...] What would happen if three entrepreneurs launched a company tomorrow that did exactly what your business does today? They have no legacy code, limited overhead, and no established processes to work around. They're building from scratch with AI embedded in how they develop products and serve customers. And they're targeting the same customers you've spent years acquiring and retaining. [...] AI-first thinking helps growth-stage companies evaluate how artificial intelligence could reshape their products, operating models, and competitive advantages. As AI-native competitors enter established markets, CEOs must consider how AI can accelerate innovation and improve customer value. Incorporating that perspective into strategic planning can help companies sustain growth and build long-term enterprise value.

“Together, DuPont’s teams can build on the data and expertise they have today, within the workflows they already use, to explore far more ideas in silico, through computer simulation, so physical testing goes to the candidates most worth pursuing,” NobleAI CEO Alex Wang said in the release. It returns a health summary per ASIN, the diagnosis with evidence, and a ranked fix list, labeling any [...] Figure 4: The Inventory Launch Prep agent comparing FBA and AWD fulfillment per factor and recommending a hybrid approach

The agent reads supplier data and weighs the fulfillment options per SKU on inbound cost, storage, and speed to sellable. It walks through placement choices and returns the output the seller picks: a shipping plan, a cost comparison, or a combined packet. It explains its reasoning and confirms before it creates anything.
